A mismatch prints `lnpeer_fingerprint match failure` and docs/php/streams.md:| `stream_wrapper_restore()` | `stream_wrapper_restore(string $protocol): bool` | Clears the disabled bit `stream_wrapper_unregister()` set on a built-in wrapper, and answers PHP's three cases. A wrapper that really was unregistered is restored silently and reports `true`. One that was never unregistered reports `true` with `Notice: stream_wrapper_restore(): <proto>:// was never changed, nothing to restore`. A scheme that never existed reports `false` with `lnstream_wrapper_restore(): <proto>:// never existed, nothing to restore`, which `@` suppresses. Following elephc's convention for every diagnostic, the Notice goes to stdout through the output-buffer funnel and the Warning to stderr; PHP CLI puts both on stdout, a repo-wide divergence rather than one specific to this builtin. |
